cases.reported_obligation: The agreement includes incremental-cost recovery through contributions in aid of construction, other advance payments and minimum monthly bills, with collateral and termination provisions.
cases.model_treatment: A bundled generation/transmission contract cannot be treated as embedded-only without a contract-specific reconciliation. Utility-estimated customer savings are not a clean measure of transmission payments or BAAJA uplift.

limitation: These examples establish that prior obligations exist, not their national prevalence or their precise overlap with a future BAAJA tariff. Prior-recovery sensitivities are assumptions, not empirical deductions.
